title: Ghost Guide
body: A haunted-easy way to find your way around Jaypee University of Engineering & Technology. Scroll and the ghost will show you around, or skip straight to the map.

title: Main Gate
body: The main entry off the AB Road. The main road in front of the gate and the hostels carries the tuck shops and cafeteria, with a pathway leading to the Annapurna mess.

title: Lake of JUET & Helipad
body: The western loop wraps around the campus lake. Just south-east of it sits the helipad.

title: Academic Core
body: JUET's three academic blocks are Ramanujan Bhawan, Raman Bhawan and Vishvesvaraya Bhawan. LT-1 is in Ramanujan Bhawan and the Learning Resource Centre (library) is in Vishvesvaraya Bhawan, with LT-2 to LT-5 across the academic area.

title: Annapurna
body: Annapurna is the student mess. JUET runs separate Annapurna messes for boys and girls, serving students and employees.

title: Boys' Hostels
body: JUET lists 21 boys' hostel blocks, built in this Y shape, plus a separate girls' hostel. Search a block number such as 'H7' to jump straight to it.

title: Sports & East Side
body: On the east side are the handball court and the Department of Civil Engineering, with a large hall to the south.

title: Faculty Residences
body: Faculty and staff housing fills the southern part of the campus, inside the big loop road.

title: Now it's your turn
body: Search for a building, filter by facility, or get step-free walking directions. The map is all yours.
